description: This file defines the ProfilesController class, which handles HTTP requests related to user profiles within the Conduit application. It uses dependency injection to access the mediator and provides an endpoint to get profile details based on username.

classes.name: ProfilesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for profile-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing MediatR to handle queries.
